questions.explanation: Photosynthesis, Respiration and Fermentation are biochemical metabolic processes. Pollination is a reproductive transfer process in plants. Hence, Pollination is the odd one out.
Legislature, Executive and Judiciary are the three organs of government. Election Commission is a constitutional authority, not an organ of government. Hence, Election Commission is the odd one out.
Ajanta, Ellora and Sanchi are associated mainly with Buddhist heritage. Konark is primarily a Hindu Sun temple. Hence, Konark is the odd one out.
Granite, Basalt and Marble are rocks. Quartz is a mineral. Hence, Quartz is the odd one out.
Hydrogen, Nitrogen and Oxygen are elemental gases. Ozone is an allotrope of oxygen containing three oxygen atoms. Hence, Ozone is the odd one out.
CPU, RAM and ROM are internal computer components. Scanner is an external input device. Hence, Scanner is the odd one out.
Census, Survey and Sampling are data collection methods in statistics. Experiment is primarily a scientific testing method. Hence, Experiment is the odd one out.
Copper, Silver and Gold are metals with high electrical conductivity. Graphite is a non-metal. Hence, Graphite is the odd one out.
Metre, Kilogram and Kelvin are SI base units. Litre is not an SI base unit. Hence, Litre is the odd one out.
Amazon, Nile and Yangtze are rivers. Pacific is an ocean. Hence, Pacific is the odd one out.
Plasma, Solid and Liquid are states of matter. Steam is a specific gaseous form of water. Hence, Steam is the odd one out.
Maurya, Gupta and Chola are ancient Indian dynasties. Mughal belongs to medieval Indian history. Hence, Mughal is the odd one out.
Democracy, Monarchy and Republic are forms of government. Parliament is a legislative institution. Hence, Parliament is the odd one out.
Violin, Guitar and Sitar are string instruments. Flute is a wind instrument. Hence, Flute is the odd one out.
DNA, RNA and Chromosome are directly related to hereditary material. Protein is a biomolecule but not hereditary material itself. Hence, Protein is the odd one out.
Latitude, Longitude and Tropic of Cancer are imaginary reference lines. Hemisphere is a division of Earth. Hence, Hemisphere is the odd one out.
Mercury, Venus and Mars are planets. Europa is a satellite of Jupiter. Hence, Europa is the odd one out.
Insulin, Adrenaline and Thyroxine are hormones. Pepsin is an enzyme. Hence, Pepsin is the odd one out.
Panchayat, Municipality and Corporation are local self-government institutions. Secretariat is an administrative office. Hence, Secretariat is the odd one out.
K2, Everest and Kanchenjunga are mountain peaks. Aravalli is a mountain range. Hence, Aravalli is the odd one out.
Boron, Silicon and Germanium are metalloids. Sulphur is a non-metal. Hence, Sulphur is the odd one out.
Harappa, Mohenjo-daro and Lothal are Indus Valley Civilization sites. Nalanda was an ancient university. Hence, Nalanda is the odd one out.
Speed, Velocity and Acceleration are rates involving time. Distance is not a rate quantity. Hence, Distance is the odd one out.
Algebra, Geometry and Trigonometry are branches of mathematics. Cartography is map-making. Hence, Cartography is the odd one out.
Hydrochloric acid, Sulphuric acid and Nitric acid are acids. Ammonia is a basic compound. Hence, Ammonia is the odd one out.
Tiger, Leopard and Cheetah belong to the cat family. Wolf belongs to the dog family. Hence, Wolf is the odd one out.
Shakespeare, Milton and Wordsworth are English literary figures. Picasso was a painter. Hence, Picasso is the odd one out.
Vaccine, Antibiotic and Antiseptic are associated with medicine and disease control. Fertilizer is used in agriculture. Hence, Fertilizer is the odd one out.
Teak, Sal and Pine are trees. Bamboo is a grass. Hence, Bamboo is the odd one out.
Binary, Decimal and Hexadecimal are number systems. Alphabetical is not a number system. Hence, Alphabetical is the odd one out.
Neuron, Axon and Dendrite are related to the nervous system. Alveoli are air sacs in lungs. Hence, Alveoli is the odd one out.
Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha and Vidhan Sabha are legislative bodies. Supreme Court is a judicial institution. Hence, Supreme Court is the odd one out.
Carbon dioxide, Methane and Nitrous oxide are greenhouse gases. Oxygen is not a greenhouse gas. Hence, Oxygen is the odd one out.
Liver, Pancreas and Kidney are organs. Neuron is a cell. Hence, Neuron is the odd one out.
Acropolis, Colosseum and Pantheon are ancient Greco-Roman structures. Fatehpur Sikri is a Mughal city complex in India. Hence, Fatehpur Sikri is the odd one out.
Tornado, Cyclone and Typhoon are atmospheric wind storms. Tsunami is a sea wave caused by underwater disturbances. Hence, Tsunami is the odd one out.
Noun, Pronoun and Verb are major parts of speech categories. Article is a subcategory of adjectives/determiners. Hence, Article is the odd one out.

Conductor, Insulator and Semiconductor classify materials based on electrical conductivity in solid-state physics. Electrolyte conducts through ions in solution. Hence, Electrolyte is the odd one out.
Batsman, Bowler and Wicketkeeper are players in cricket. Referee is an official. Hence, Referee is the odd one out.
XML, HTML and CSS are markup/style languages used in web development. HTTP is a communication protocol. Hence, HTTP is the odd one out.
$64 = 4^3$, $125 = 5^3$ and $216 = 6^3$ are perfect cubes. $400$ is not a perfect cube. Hence, $400$ is the odd one out.
ACEG, BDFH and CEGI follow a constant alphabet gap of $+2$. DFIK has inconsistent gaps. Hence, DFIK is the odd one out.
$121 = 11^2$, $144 = 12^2$ and $169 = 13^2$ are consecutive perfect squares. $225 = 15^2$ skips $14^2$. Hence, $225$ is the odd one out.
MPSV, ORUX and PSVY follow a constant gap of $+3$ letters. NQTW breaks the sequence consistency in alphabetical progression. Hence, NQTW is the odd one out.
$32$, $64$ and $128$ are powers of $2$. $196$ is not a power of $2$. Hence, $196$ is the odd one out.
ABCD, EFGH and PQRS begin with alternating positions maintaining equal block patterns. JKLM breaks the alphabetical spacing progression. Hence, JKLM is the odd one out.
$45$, $54$ and $63$ have digit sums equal to $9$. $72$ also has digit sum $9$ but breaks the arithmetic progression increasing by $9$. Hence, $72$ is the odd one out.
CFI, DGJ and EHK maintain a constant gap of $+3$ with systematic progression. FIL shifts the starting pattern alignment. Hence, FIL is the odd one out.
$81 = 3^4$, $243 = 3^5$ and $729 = 3^6$ are powers of $3$. $625 = 5^4$ is not a power of $3$. Hence, $625$ is the odd one out.

AZ, BY and CX contain pairs whose alphabetical positions add to $27$. In EV, $5 + 22 = 27$, but the ordered reverse pairing sequence is broken because DV should precede it. Hence, EV is the odd one out.
$14$, $28$ and $42$ are multiples of $14$. $58$ is not divisible by $14$. Hence, $58$ is the odd one out.
GKOS, HLPT and IMQU maintain equal gaps of $+4$. JNRV has inconsistent spacing. Hence, JNRV is the odd one out.
$49 = 7^2$, $121 = 11^2$ and $169 = 13^2$ are squares of prime numbers. $256 = 16^2$ is not a square of a prime number. Hence, $256$ is the odd one out.
CEG, DFH and EGI start from consecutive letters while maintaining alternate progression. BDF breaks the ordered starting alignment. Hence, BDF is the odd one out.
$125 = 5^3$, $216 = 6^3$ and $729 = 9^3$ are cubes of odd/even consecutive patterns. $512 = 8^3$ breaks the established numerical progression. Hence, $512$ is the odd one out.
MNOP, QRST and UVWX are continuous alphabetical blocks without cyclic restart. YZAB wraps around alphabetically. Hence, YZAB is the odd one out.
$18$, $27$ and $36$ are multiples of $9$. $50$ is not divisible by $9$. Hence, $50$ is the odd one out.
AFKP, BGLQ and CHMR follow a constant gap of $+5$. DINS has unequal spacing. Hence, DINS is the odd one out.
$100 = 10^2$, $144 = 12^2$ and $196 = 14^2$ are squares of even numbers. $225 = 15^2$ is square of an odd number. Hence, $225$ is the odd one out.
PQSU, RSUW and STVX follow alternating skip-letter progression. QRTV breaks the internal letter gap pattern. Hence, QRTV is the odd one out.
$27 = 3^3$, $64 = 4^3$ and $125 = 5^3$ are consecutive perfect cubes. $225$ is not a perfect cube. Hence, $225$ is the odd one out.
ABEF, CDGH and GHKL maintain equal grouped pair spacing. EFIJ disturbs the ordered progression. Hence, EFIJ is the odd one out.
$22$, $33$ and $44$ are repeated-digit numbers. $57$ is not. Hence, $57$ is the odd one out.
ILO, JMP and KNQ follow equal alphabetical increments. LOR changes the internal gap structure. Hence, LOR is the odd one out.
$343 = 7^3$, $512 = 8^3$ and $729 = 9^3$ are perfect cubes. $900$ is not a perfect cube. Hence, $900$ is the odd one out.
DFH, GIK and JLN begin from every third letter maintaining structured alignment. ACE starts from a different base arrangement. Hence, ACE is the odd one out.
$15$, $35$ and $55$ end with digit $5$. $70$ ends with $0$. Hence, $70$ is the odd one out.
UVWX, QRST and MNOP begin from letters positioned at intervals of $4$. JKLM breaks the reverse alphabetical block arrangement. Hence, JKLM is the odd one out.
$81 = 9^2$, $169 = 13^2$ and $289 = 17^2$ are squares of prime-related odd numbers. $400 = 20^2$ is square of an even composite number. Hence, $400$ is the odd one out.
CFK, DGL and EHM follow equal alphabetical increment progression. BEJ disturbs the incremental structure. Hence, BEJ is the odd one out.
$24$, $48$ and $72$ are multiples of $24$. $95$ is not divisible by $24$. Hence, $95$ is the odd one out.
KMOQ, LNPR and NPRT follow alternate alphabetical progression with equal spacing. MOQS breaks the internal sequence pattern. Hence, MOQS is the odd one out.
$125 = 5^3$, $343 = 7^3$ and $729 = 9^3$ are cubes of odd numbers. $1024 = 2^{10}$ is not a cube. Hence, $1024$ is the odd one out.
RST, UVW and XYZ are straight consecutive alphabetical groups without wraparound. YZA restarts from A. Hence, YZA is the odd one out.
$36 = 6^2$, $49 = 7^2$ and $64 = 8^2$ are consecutive perfect squares. $90$ is not a perfect square. Hence, $90$ is the odd one out.
ADG, BEH and CFI maintain equal gaps of $+3$. DHK has unequal spacing. Hence, DHK is the odd one out.
$81 = 9^2$, $256 = 16^2$ and $625 = 25^2$ are squares of perfect squares. $16 = 4^2$ does not fit the larger square progression pattern. Hence, $16$ is the odd one out.
AFK, BGL and CHM maintain equal alphabetical gaps of $+5$. DIN changes the gap structure. Hence, DIN is the odd one out.
$18$, $54$ and $90$ are multiples of $18$. $125$ is not divisible by $18$. Hence, $125$ is the odd one out.
QRSU, RSTV and STUW follow a shifting consecutive progression with one skipped letter at the end. PQRT breaks the established structure. Hence, PQRT is the odd one out.
